summary: Decent Holding Inc., a PRC-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on November 5, 2026 its board adopted the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the US-equivalent of a routine equity compensation plan adoption). The plan initially authorizes up to 200,000 Class A ordinary shares for issuance as options, SARs, restricted shares, RSUs, bonus and performance awards to directors, officers, employees, consultants and advisors. No price, premium, stake, advisor or board recommendation on a transaction is stated. This is a compensation/ governance item, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
